<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: pour-qui
## Start with your purpose.
summary: A course, a briefing, a collection or an identity to share.

The reader needs a clear route. The author needs editable sources. The designer needs reusable choices. The maintainer needs a deliverable that can be kept and rebuilt. These can all be the same person; an agent can also take part in the work.

<div class="lwp-web-actions"><a class="lwp-web-button" href="usages.html">Explore the six routes →</a></div>

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: deux-usages
## The overview and the detail stay together.
summary: Cards guide a presentation. The full article gives the explanation a place to live.

Open the library briefing to see a proposal, its comparison table and the complete working note. Follow its cards or jump straight to the long text. You choose the depth you need.

<div class="lwp-web-actions"><a class="lwp-web-button" href="demo/library.html#detail">Read the complete note →</a></div>

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: commandes
## A reader menu. Not a keyboard requirement.
summary: On a phone, tap the menu to reach zoom − / + / Reset, text fitting and table scrolling.

Presentation zoom magnifies the document. Native pinch remains your browser’s zoom. The help offers touch and keyboard guidance. You can also change appearance or share the current card from the controls.

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: une-source
## Keep the material you can edit.
summary: Markdown sources, images and a series file describe the document.

Write them yourself, guide an external agent or automate a build. The browser builder and the command line use the same rendering engine. They do not decide your argument or supply an authoring agent.

<div class="lwp-web-actions"><a class="lwp-web-button" href="demarrer.html">Choose your starting point →</a></div>

---

<!-- lwp:slide -->
slug: fichiers-libres
## Hand over a document, not the generator.
summary: The reader opens HTML in a browser. Keep referenced images and kit assets with the pages.

Publish the complete output directory on static hosting, or share the files directly. Keep the source project for editing and rebuilding.

<div class="lwp-web-actions"><a class="lwp-web-button" href="publier.html">Prepare your publication →</a></div>
